name: se
description: Turn ideas into clear Feature plans, deliver them through reviewed pull requests, maintain project knowledge, and audit active work.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Features, deliver reviewed pull requests, and maintain project knowledge.
interface.longDescription: SE supports a graph-first software-delivery workflow. Learn maintains durable project knowledge, Idea captures proposals, and Feature uses one explicitly profiled planner plus a small transient graph to publish evidence-backed Feature Plan Sets without task-bootstrap bureaucracy. Implement uses one visible graph orchestrator, coordinates reusable repository workers, chooses serial or concurrent execution, uses a tiny host-local repository-ownership registry, and produces standalone or same-repository stacked pull requests without an execution ledger. Audit observes active SE work without making changes. Implement leaves merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure to the user.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:learn to maintain durable repository knowledge, or $se:idea to save a proposal for later planning.
Use $se:feature to turn related requests into Feature issues and Macro Tasks without writing code.
Use $se:implement for lightweight reusable-worker delivery and standalone or stacked pull requests.
